title: Deep Research
description: Run a bounded, evidence-grounded research investigation over BrainPilot's enabled paper library and Tavily search, inspired by the pinned GPT Researcher approach: plan a small set of research branches, gather and read sources, record every claim against the source that supports it, and produce a literature/research report with its source list, claim-to-source map, research tree, and the questions that remained unresolved.
applicableWhen: The user requests a bounded literature synthesis, research comparison, or state-of-the-art overview that must be supported by identifiable sources.
The current host and PI model can reach source-supported evidence through the enabled paper library or Tavily tools and can write report artifacts.
notApplicableWhen: A simple fact lookup, definition, or single-source answer would satisfy the request.
Drafting or revising a research manuscript, which the paper-writing workflow covers.
Running dataset experiments or analyses, or producing clinical, diagnostic, or treatment recommendations.

question.description: The single research question the report must answer.

scope.description: What the investigation must cover: topics, populations, methods, comparisons, and the depth expected.

exclusions.description: Topics, sources, or directions the investigation must stay out of.

cutoffDate.description: Inclusive evidence cutoff as YYYY-MM-DD; sources published after this date are excluded. Calendar validity is checked outside this schema.

language.description: Language of the written report. Evidence may be in any language.

inputPaths.description: Existing workspace text files to read as starting material.

budget.description: Orchestration and research-call limits for this run. These bound branches, stages, and research tool calls; they are not a token budget and not a cap on the HTTP calls a single research tool makes internally. Effective defaults are applied by the implementation; omitted fields are not filled in by this schema.

outputSchema.description: Successful completion only. A partial or failed run writes its diagnostic artifacts and then fails, and must not validate here.

unresolvedGaps.description: Questions the run could not settle from the evidence it gathered. Empty only when no gap remained.
